note: The intended update per slide, shown in the organizer under the speaker notes. Written against style-guide/principles.md: each entry says which of the three treatments the slide belongs to, which principles it adopts, and what actually changes. Speaker notes stay the spoken script; this is the build intent.

intents.opening-scene: Done 16 Sep: its grid is now the show-wide debug grid (g, and the organizer). The pen and the wall are unchanged; the breathe under the pieces is still to do. — Catalogue, and the clearest statement of it in the show. Nothing about the pen changes: drawing an outline slowly and flooding it is an earned exception to the five moves. Take the palette and the type scale so the register lettering matches every other wall, and add Breathe under the pieces so a wall that stands for an hour is not literally static. The ground stays black, the ink stays white, and there is no accent here. Its ruled grid with the small titles is worth more than this wall: it becomes a debug grid over the whole show, drawn on the window so it never lands in a still, switched from the organizer beside the concrete toggle, and possibly a layer some slides keep.
intents.who-is-speaking: Done 16 Sep (second round): the right pane is plain black again. The opening wall was drawn into it for a day; a drawing that moves beside a name being read is a second thing to attend to, and this moment wants none. The name stays in the left pane. — Done 16 Sep: the opening wall draws itself in the right pane while the name stands on the left. — Catalogue, used as a title card. The left wall carries the name and the right is empty, which the projection brief allows, so do not fill it with furniture. Better: let the opening wall's pen keep drawing on the right, so the arrival continues while the name stands. Name at display size, company at label, role at body, one red rule as the only accent.
intents.het-programma: Done 16 Sep (second round): the rules that ran from each course name out to the edge of the list are gone — a dozen long lines down the pane read as ruling rather than as quiet spacing. — Done 16 Sep: the list is a menu — chapters large, courses as rules — with no wordmark; the right pane holds one message at a time and, at the end, all four. — Technical drawing, because it is a plan of the evening rather than a title. Set the left as a menu: the four chapters at title size with the courses as quiet rules between them, red numerals as the accent. The right holds one chapter's message at a time, arriving on Arrive and changing on Swap. Drop the large Het programma wordmark; the list is the title.
intents.welcome: Done 16 Sep: arrives on a cut. The grain strength per wall is still to do. — Catalogue. Arrive on a cut, not a dissolve out of the programme, because this is a new subject. Palette on black with the house pair, and the grain at its reduced strength so the saturated red and blue stop reading as mud. The indexing belt keeps its own move; piece names go to caption size.
intents.hoe-bouw-je-een-wereld: Done 16 Sep (third round): the line above the quote is gone, here and on every other quote in the show — the four chapter openings and the four takeaways, "Om mee te nemen" included. A title over a quote is read first and is not the quote. What the recap said is the speaker's to say. QuoteSlide no longer carries a lead at all. — Done 16 Sep: a recap line stands above the question (DRAFT wording). — Drawing, as plain type. It should carry two things rather than one: a quiet recap line of where the evening has got to, then the chapter's question at title size. That is the re-entry the narrative plan asks for at every chapter opening, and this is the one place it can live.
intents.the-catalogue-city: Done 16 Sep (second round): the opening is a soft zoom with no pan, and the town comes up out of nothing behind a soft front — plan by plan, a fifth of them fading at any moment, drawn as a settled run plus two dozen bands so it costs a couple of dozen draw calls rather than seven thousand. — Done 16 Sep: the opening zooms in softly from a little further out with a small pan, and the cull is its own 3.5 s click. — Catalogue at the scale of a town. Its opening changes: start a little further out than today and zoom in softly for the reveal, with a small pan, so the town is arrived at rather than presented. It is also the slide that proves clicks need their own lengths: the push wants twelve seconds and the cull wants three, and today they are the same click. The surviving element should turn accent as it becomes the tree's root, so the handover is a change of role rather than a change of colour.
intents.everything-a-build-answers-to: Done 16 Sep (third round): while a highlight is the only thing on the pane it stands beside the root, half a row off the middle, so the word can be read; the click that opens the fan carries it out to its own row with everything else. Locatie is on the left branch and Constructiekeuzes on the right, so the slide reads left, then right, then all of it. — Done 16 Sep: Locatie on click 1, Constructiekeuzes on click 2, the fan on click 3; the two stay in the accent. — Drawing. Keeps the invisible handover from the city, which is the Mark principle working exactly as intended. The fan opening middle-out is Arrive's stagger and should be the example the class is written from. Labels stay one size across both columns. The build gains two clicks before the fan: the first click highlights one thing, the second a second thing, and only then does the click that exists today reveal them all, so the speaker can name two before the room sees forty.
intents.the-globe: Done 16 September, on the feedback that the globe should look like the Crowd slide's grid lines but made of objects: the disc is no longer flat but a globe whose meridians and parallels are drawn as strings of catalogue pieces — white meridians travelling east as it turns, blue parallels standing still, only the near half drawn and each piece a little smaller toward the rim. A judgement call inside that: Crowd's own approach, a full field of pieces with the ones a line passes through picked out in blue, was built first and does not survive the change of subject — Crowd's figures are one narrow silhouette repeated so a coloured run reads as a line, where a hundred components at a hundred widths read as speckle whatever the colour. Drawing only the lines says the same thing and leaves the disc small enough that the ring of words is still set at label size. — Drawing. It builds on its own clock rather than on clicks, which is right for a slide you talk over. Nothing changes but taking colour and type from the roles instead of stating them.
intents.verticale-integratie: Done 16 Sep (third round): the tiled field of pieces is gone. A bar is one plain box drawn with the contour of the notched slab that had stood on "Eigen transport" — stretched to whatever box it fills, so the box keeps the profile and nothing else. Stated as barPiece rather than derived from the row order, so re-ordering the rows cannot change what the stack is drawn with. — Done 16 Sep (second round): a click is one box rather than one row, the last two rows are a pair like the ones above, and every bar is a field of one catalogue piece off the subset with the holed pieces left out. The piece is sized to a share of the pane rather than to the band, so the grain is the same on the opening band and on the last. — Done 16 Sep: every band blue, the last no longer red. Grow from the top edge still to do. — Drawing. The bands should Grow down from their own top edge rather than fade in, so the stack reads as being built. Every band is structure blue, the last one included: it is no longer picked out in red. One type size across the whole stack, which it already does.
intents.de-cijfers: Done 16 Sep (third round): the rotation is the sketch's own wave again. It was a clamped ramp — every slab more than one place off centre sat at the same extreme angle, so a slab entering the frame stood still until it crossed the clamp, and the depth had a corner in it at the middle. Turn and depth are now a sine of how far off centre a slab is, continuous everywhere, with the centred slab square to the room and nearest the eye; the train is painted back to front so the figure being read is on top. — Done 16 Sep: one slide of eight clicks, a figure a click, centred and close up; six countries. — Sculpture carrying type. Done on 16 September: it absorbed the travelling slabs into one slide of eight clicks. One block stands centred and close up; each click brings the next figure into the middle while its neighbours turn away and step back, so the run reads a figure at a time rather than as a train passing. The country list now names six countries. Figures at display size, blue as structure, black paper. Open question for WN: whether the omzet is the Dutch company or the group.
intents.de-fabrieken: Done 16 Sep: every site off the contact page as a small blue dot, the sea blue; the Netherlands is an office at Nieuwkuijk, not a plant. The takeaway now closes the chapter after it. — Drawing, as a map. It carries every Willy Naessens location, not only the factories: the contact page at willynaessens.be lists them and is the source, the factories stay as they are and every other site is a small blue dot. The sea turns blue so it reads as sea against the grey land. It also needs the Dutch sites: thirteen Belgian and French factories under a speaker from Willy Naessens Nederland does not hold. The bottom bar becomes a Frame region, the selected dot's slow colour pulse stays as the one sanctioned accent behaviour. This slide closes chapter one, so the chapter's takeaway has to land here or in a state after it.
intents.gallery: Sculpture, and the best wall in the show. White pieces on black with red shadows, all from the palette. Add Breathe so the light has somewhere to go besides the pieces turning, and hold it for a full cycle when filming.
intents.esg-is-geen-checklist: Done 16 Sep: one wording shared with the programme (systematische), and a recap line above. — Drawing, as type. Recap line, then the question. The wording has to match the programme wall exactly; today the two say the same sentence differently, and systemische is probably meant to be systematische.
intents.esg-beoordelingskader: Drawing. The three pieces are Slots: they arrive, then the joint closes. Today all three are red at once; the one being named should be the accent and the other two structure, which is what the chapter four callback already does. Making them behave alike is most of what ties the two slides together.
intents.co2-prestatieladder: Drawing, and the reference slide for two principles at once: Slots for the collapse of five rungs into three, and Swap for the text changing under them. The classes should be extracted from this drawer rather than written fresh. Content unchanged until WN confirms the levels and the reason the ladder changed.
intents.co2-behaald: Done 16 Sep: three bullets a chart, the rest in the notes. Axis units still to do. — Drawing. Nine bullets is a page, not a slide: three a chart at body size and the rest into the speaker notes. Both axes need their unit stated and the indexed measure explained in one line, which neither chart does today. Bars Grow from the axis, the target line draws across, every label on a Leader.
intents.geen-compensatie: Done 16 Sep: a mark an illustration, and its own title. — Done 16 Sep: the certificate goes on click 1 with its line, then one measure a click; its own title. — Drawing. The slide is called Geen compensatie and the certificate leaves without saying anything: give it one line as it goes, niet compenseren maar reduceren. Once the certificate has gone, the electrification steps are revealed one illustration a click rather than all at once, so each measure gets its sentence. The six illustrations take one box size and one white ink; the certificate is the only accent on the wall.
intents.domino-effect: Done 16 Sep (third round): the multiplication is a zoom out rather than a re-deal. Every tree keeps its place on a lattice measured from the middle of the field and only the division changes, in log space, so the tree the slide opens on never moves — it shrinks in the middle while the ring around it comes in from beyond the edge. The grids are odd for that reason: a zoom needs something at its centre to hold still, so one, nine, twenty-five rather than one, four, sixteen. And DUURZAAM is packed out of the catalogue — the word set into a plate nobody sees and read back by a quadtree, big pieces through the middle of a stroke and small ones tracing its edge, 1445 elements arriving one at a time over a click of its own. — Done 16 Sep: its own title. — Drawing. It should not share the carbon ladder's title, which today names a ladder over a decision tree. The multiplication from one tree to four to sixteen is Slots at cell scale: each tree travels to its new cell while the newcomers grow from their own middles. No photograph under the word.
intents.esg-social-governance: Done 16 Sep (third round): the arrow has its point back. The head tapered to nothing at the tip, so the innermost row fell outside the polygon well before it and the last eighth of the head carried no figures — the arrow came out blunt with the leader standing beyond a gap. The taper now runs down to a row either side of the axis, which is as fine a point as a grid of figures can come to. — Drawing, and the other reference slide for Slots. The globe state's blue is structure rather than a fourth colour. This slide closes chapter two, so it carries the chapter's takeaway and the bridge into the concrete.
intents.shadows: Done 16 Sep: held for all three forms on a filmed run, a shorter bare seam (hold 1.3). — Sculpture. Hold it long enough for all three forms, which today it never is, so the triangle is never seen. Shorten the bare grid at each seam. The sun should Breathe rather than dip and return, so the wall never looks like it is resetting.
intents.we-gieten-kennis: Done 16 Sep: a recap line above the question. — Drawing, as type. Recap, then the chapter's question.
intents.co2-impact-van-beton: Done 16 Sep: the column a third of the pane, the paragraph beside it in clear space; cement the accent; the blues one blue at four values. — Done 16 Sep: cement named as the accent, the four blues one blue at four values, Energieproductie. The narrower column and the paragraph beside it are still to do. — Drawing. The column takes most of the pane and the paragraph stands inside the red band; narrow the column and set the paragraph beside it in clear space. The bands are already Slots keyed by name, which is right. The four blues should be one structure blue at four values rather than four unrelated hues, and cement is the accent.
intents.levenscyclus-van-betonproducten: Done 16 Sep: a click mark as each column lands. — Done 16 Sep: compounds closed, B1-B5, C4 Verwijdering, one vocabulary with chapter 4. — Drawing. Dutch compounds closed: grondstofwinning, fabricageplek, constructieplek. The column headed B4-B5 runs B1 to B5, and C4 Ontdoen van is cut off mid-phrase. The columns Grow and The Circle replacing the end-of-life column is a Slots swap, not a cut.
intents.levenscyclusanalyse: Done 16 Sep: aangekochte, CO2-impact through the subscript setter, one word in the title. — Drawing. Database van aangekochte materialen, and Co2 impact set as CO2 through the subscript setter like every other carbon figure on the wall. The leaders are already the principle working; they become the shared class.
intents.verduurzamen-van-beton: Drawing, three panels. The bars Grow staggered, the scatter separating is its own earned move, the lime cycle turns on the slide's clock. One phrase has to come from WN before it can be set: nul-loos processen is not a Dutch phrase anyone can read.
intents.verborgen-verhaal: Done 16 Sep: WAND_27 under gevelelementen, the TT plate under gewelven, the TANDBALK under gewapend beton; the leader lands on the red level. — Sculpture with drawing furniture on it, and the piece has to match its claim. Today a beam carries the facade figure and a wall carries the floor figure. Put the wall panel under gevelelementen, a floor piece under gewelven and a beam under gewapend beton, or the slide contradicts itself to anyone who knows the products. The white leader lands on the red level of the piece itself, where the saving is drawn, rather than on a corner of the box, so the line and the figure are one thing.
intents.recyclage: Sculpture. The shatter is an earned exception and stays. The stages travelling left are Slots at column scale. Palette roles rather than stated blues, and the grit and shards take the ink value so the red is free for what is being said.
intents.panels-turning: Done 16 Sep: a takeaway state (kernboodschap-3) now closes the chapter after it. — Currently closes chapter three with a decorative loop that says nothing, which both briefs flag. Either it carries the chapter's takeaway line, or it moves and a takeaway state closes the chapter instead. As a picture it is fine; as an ending it is not.
intents.yard: Done 16 Sep: the row tightened (gap 0.012) and a navy shadow that reads on black. Breathe still to do. — Sculpture, and the weakest wall as it stands: one red piece adrift in black with shadows that do not read. Keep the black, tighten the row so three or four pieces are in view, and lift the shadow to a navy that shows against the ground. Add Breathe. Then it earns its place as the wall that carries the concrete chapter into The Circle.
intents.shadow-type-soft: Off, and it stays off. Keep it as the recorded alternative to the hard shadow wall so the decision is visible, but do not reactivate it by implication.
intents.we-bouwen-vandaag: Done 16 Sep: a recap line above the question. — Drawing, as type. Recap, then the question. Its first sentence is currently also the ending's sentence: one of the two should change, or the callback stops being a callback.
intents.the-circle-in-elementen: Catalogue along a path. The ink should be white rather than the grey it reads as now. Pieces land on Arrive along the ring. Blocked on the WN mark as an svg; until then the plain ring stands in and says so.
intents.100-elementen: Catalogue at its purest: every silhouette once, one height, red on black. The reshuffle is Slots. Nothing else to change, which makes it a good slide to extract the class against.
intents.gebouw-uit-de-webtool: Done 16 Sep: callouts of two or three words. — Drawing. The callouts are sentences and should be two or three words each. The red lines are the ink of this drawing rather than its accent, so the accent stays free for whatever is being pointed at. Leaders end on the building, not in space beside it.
intents.reductie-carbon-footprint: Done 16 Sep: a click mark a step. — Done 16 Sep: one vocabulary with chapter 3, Demonteren. — Drawing. The boxes Grow from their own edges and the lettering fades over the last third, which is already right. What is wrong is the vocabulary: this slide describes the same five steps as the life cycle in chapter three in a different set of words. One list, in Dutch a builder would use, across both.
intents.demontabel-in-de-stad: Done 16 Sep: pieces square to the city on middling roofs, lifted, carried and lowered one after another; the camera closer (unit 170). — Sculpture, and the motion is the thing to fix: the placement reads as strange because the pieces drift. Each piece is placed exactly on one roof, and on the click it travels to exactly one other roof and is placed exactly there, on Slots. Nothing hovers between. The pieces also sit small along the top edge and only their outlines read, so bring the camera in or choose roofs nearer the middle of the frame.
intents.block-city: Done 16 Sep: archived. — Sculpture, the ruled architectural drawing. Two block cities back to back inside chapter four is fifty seconds of wall in the middle of the talk. Keep one and move it out of the chapter; if this one stays it belongs to the technical drawing family and should be argued for on that basis.
intents.block-city-plain: Done 16 Sep: moved out of chapter 4 into the second course, after the yard. — Sculpture, the massing model in the house colours. This is the one to keep as a course wall, because navy masses on white with one red block in twenty-five is the brand picture. If it stays it moves out of chapter four and into a course.
intents.the-circle-en-esg: Done 16 Sep: a takeaway state (kernboodschap-4) now closes the chapter after it. — Drawing, and the deliberate callback to the chapter two framework. Same drawer, same colours, notes beside each piece: that is the principle of dimming the rest working well. It closes chapter four, so it carries the takeaway and the bridge into the questions.
intents.de-sectoren: Done 16 Sep: a quieter scatter (collage 0.22) so the float keeps a grouping. The sector list and wall-size caption are still to do. — Catalogue as a collage, and the slide you flagged: the floating red shapes read as chaotic. Keep the floating quality and give it a deliberate grouping, even spacing, consistent orientation and one clear focus, with the edge crops chosen rather than accidental. Fewer sectors, each with a real project, rather than twelve of which nine are guesses. The sector name goes to wall scale with the element and the counter under it.
intents.case-studies: Done 16 Sep: the drawings take 80% of the pane with the facts in clear bands, the name larger, and each case is a sequence of composed views — overview, then framed details a click, the caption replacing the facts on the framed pane. Kievits II has two placeholder regions; the facade details are for WN to name. — Technical drawing, and the one confirmed redesign in the brief: a sequence of composed views with precise transitions rather than one camera journey, so it feels like moving through an organised project file. Each view has a deliberate framing and one subject, moving from the drawing overview into a facade or construction detail and back. Facts live in stable margins outside the drawings and the dimension lines, never across them, and the project name is the largest thing on the wall. Missing facts stay visibly missing until WN supplies them.
intents.plain: Done 16 Sep: the colour cycle slowed to 90 s. The Circle elements and the score are still to do. — Sculpture as a score. The direction taken is that the wall's build is an explicit schedule of reveals that also exports as MIDI, so its timing can drive the music of the course it plays under; the wall and the sound are one instrument. Within that: the values become The Circle's own elements rather than a placeholder chart, since this is the wall after The Circle chapter, and the ground's colour change slows from eight seconds to a wall's pace, a minute or more, so it never passes through purple in front of anyone.
intents.ending: Done 16 Sep: Ontdek The Circle as the headline at title size, the code half the pane, the address white, the arrival room as its bed. The pen-drawn code is still to do. — Done 16 Sep: Ontdek The Circle. The layout around the action and the pen-drawn code are still to do. — The one thing the room is asked to act on, and the copy is currently wrong: The Circle cannot be visited, so the invitation to plan a visit has to go. Ontdek The Circle is the proposed line, with the supporting sentence confirmed against whatever the code actually reaches. The action becomes the headline, the code is large and stable enough to scan from the seats, and the address is white. Worth trying: the code drawn by the opening wall's pen, so the evening closes the way it opened.
intents.closing-scene: Done 16 Sep: on the opening's black, under the same room as the ending. — Done 16 Sep: on the opening's black. — Catalogue, the mirror of the arrival. It stands on white paper today while the opening stands on black, which is the seam that keeps the two ends of the evening from rhyming. Move it onto the opening's black with the colours swapped, and let it be the last thing rather than a different kind of thing.
intents.skew-3d: Archived, and worth reconsidering. Folded planes carrying typography is one of the reference directions on the WN board, and this is the only wall in the show that does it. If a course wall is ever short, this is the candidate.
intents.skew-3d-simple: Archived. Keep as the record of the simpler version; no work intended.
intents.shadow-type: Archived. Superseded by the shadow wall with abstract forms and by the chapter cards, which use the same facade. No work intended.
intents.kernboodschap-1: Drawing, as type: the takeaway that closes chapter 1 before the room goes to a course, headed "Om mee te nemen". Added 16 September so every chapter resolves on one sentence, which none did. The sentence is a DRAFT from the script plan's bridges, for WN and the host to approve; the wording belongs in Slideshow.kt where the chapter ends.
